title: 회식 자리에서: 건배하고, 들은 소식 묻기
objective: You can check news you heard with -ㄴ/는다면서요 or -았/었다면서요.
summary: Make a toast, pour drinks politely, and check news with -다면서요.
setting: A Friday evening team dinner at a Korean barbecue restaurant. Team leader Kim, senior coworker Minji, and Ryan, a foreign employee, are sitting together.

task.title: Talk at the team dinner
task.line: Use the dialogue and word list to change sentences, choose words, and answer in Korean.

words.meaning: a dinner or drinks with your team after work
words.example: 이번 주 금요일에 팀 회식이 있어요.
words.exampleMeaning: We have a team dinner this Friday.
Shall we make a toast before the food comes?

words.example: 윗사람에게 술을 따를 때는 두 손으로 따라요.
words.exampleMeaning: When you pour a drink for someone senior, you pour with both hands.

words.meaning: to push yourself too hard; to overdo it
words.exampleMeaning: You have work tomorrow too, so don't overdo it.
Manager Park was just promoted to department head.
Thanks to you, I learned the work quickly.

dialogue.korean: 라이언 씨, 다음 달에 고향에 간다면서요?
dialogue.meaning: Ryan, I heard you're going home next month. Is that right?

dialogue.korean: 네, 동생 결혼식이 있어서요. 그런데 민지 씨는 이번에 대리로 승진하셨다면서요? 축하드려요.
dialogue.meaning: Yes, my younger sibling is getting married. And Minji, I heard you were promoted to assistant manager. Congratulations.

dialogue.korean: 고마워요. 아, 라이언 씨는 술을 잘 못 마신다면서요? 무리하지 말고 음료수 마셔요.
dialogue.meaning: Thanks. Oh, I heard you can't drink much, Ryan. Don't push yourself. Just have a soft drink.

dialogue.korean: 감사합니다. 그럼 저는 사이다로 할게요. 팀장님, 제가 한 잔 따라 드릴게요.
dialogue.meaning: Thank you. Then I'll have a lemon-lime soda. Team leader, let me pour you a glass.

dialogue.korean: 고마워요. 라이언 씨 덕분에 이번 프로젝트가 잘 끝났어요.
dialogue.meaning: Thanks. This project went well thanks to you, Ryan.

exercises: Change each piece of news into a question that checks what you heard. Use -ㄴ/는다면서요 for present and -았/었다면서요 for past: ① 부장님이 다음 주에 출장을 가세요. ② 수진 씨가 지난주에 이사했어요. ③ 준호 씨는 매운 음식을 못 먹어요.
Choose the right word: ① 선배님 (덕분에 / 때문에) 발표를 잘 끝냈어요. ② 내일 아침에 회의가 있으니까 오늘은 (승진하지 / 무리하지) 마세요.
Choose what you should say: Your team leader's glass is empty. ⓐ 팀장님, 제 잔 좀 채워 주세요. ⓑ 팀장님, 제가 한 잔 따라 드릴게요.
Answer in Korean based on the dialogue: 라이언 씨는 왜 다음 달에 고향에 가요?
Put the words in order to make one sentence: 잘 끝났어요 / 회식이 / 총무님 / 덕분에
answers: ① 부장님이 다음 주에 출장을 가신다면서요? ② 수진 씨가 지난주에 이사했다면서요? ③ 준호 씨는 매운 음식을 못 먹는다면서요?
ⓑ 팀장님, 제가 한 잔 따라 드릴게요.
총무님 덕분에 회식이 잘 끝났어요. (회식이 총무님 덕분에 잘 끝났어요.)
